tips.text: Buy it whenever Baro has it; the next chance can be months away and is never announced.
Crack relics in quick public missions the week before Baro lands, so 550 Ducats and 325,000 credits are banked.
Leave it unranked with no Forma or Catalyst if you plan to trade it.
Keep it out of a Duviri Circuit rotation pick if you plan to trade it; the Circuit can rank your copy to 30.
Players treat it as a one-and-done armor-strip tool; Unairu's Caustic Strike or Sarpa cover most of the job if you cannot wait for Baro.
